player_0.content: I got stuck in a loop between the Gallery and Playroom, repeatedly moving east and west without exploring other options. I failed to recognize that the Playroom offered a "north" direction which I ignored, and I prematurely chose "DONE" while unvisited rooms remained accessible. Next time, I will strictly avoid returning to the previous room immediately; instead, I will always attempt to move in a new, untried direction (e.g., north from Playroom) before considering stopping. I will only issue "DONE" after confirming that all reachable directions have been exhausted and no new rooms can be found.
